local self=require('openmw.self')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local timer=0
local ready,turned,approached=false,false,false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt) timer=timer+dt if timer>0.5 then timer=0 print('Sewer rotation yaw='..tostring(self.controls.yawChange)..' camera='..tostring(camera.getYaw())..' facing='..tostring(self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0)))) end if not approached and self.position.y>=3100 then approached=true print('Sewer Player reached sunken room') end local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0)) if not ready then ready=true print('Sewer Player frame ready heading '..tostring(f)) end if not turned and f.x>=0 and f.y>0.9 then turned=true print('Sewer Player facing north') end end}}}}
